gates.name: DOMAIN_FRESHNESS
gates.semantics: Stale or unknown domain authority blocks admission.

gates.name: PLAYER_COUNT
requires: requested player count in qualified technical scope
official default deck-decision evidence exactly 4 players

gates.name: RULES_CONFORMANCE
requires: all production-reachable general rules semantics in the admitted closure are qualified
gates.semantics: No partial closure may be promoted to PASS.

gates.name: CARD_REACHABILITY
requires: all production-reachable card and interaction semantics for exact admitted domain are qualified
gates.semantics: Runtime behavior is required where behavior is claimed.

gates.name: PILOT_AUTHORITY
requires: Rules Core is sole legality authority
gates.semantics: No second rules engine in pilot/adapter.

gates.name: HIDDEN_INFO
requires: no private-state leak in production artifacts
gates.semantics: All outbound fields are part of the leakage boundary.

gates.name: RNG
gates.semantics: Rules RNG and pilot RNG are distinct.

gates.name: REPLAY
requires: clean-process semantic replay under same manifest

gates.name: COMMANDER_MULTIPLAYER
requires: all relevant Commander and multiplayer semantics including applicable Partner semantics
gates.semantics: Runtime fixtures are required for MUST semantics.

gates.name: RUNTIME_RELIABILITY
requires: no timeout under frozen campaign policy
gates.semantics: Technical failure remains evidence and may not be replaced.

gates.name: INTEROP_LICENSE
requires: technical interoperability and licensing compatibility for actual integration/distribution model
gates.semantics: Forge must remain across genuine separate-process/service boundary under WS-09.

gates.name: GAME_ADMISSION
gates.semantics: A game is Full-Rules production evidence only when all pre-admission gates PASS.

gates.name: DECISION_CAMPAIGN
gates.semantics: Campaign evidence cannot repair qualification gaps.

gates.name: HOLDOUT
requires: only required if enabled by campaign contract
gates.semantics: NOT_APPLICABLE only when campaign contract disables holdout.
